meta.title: Mumm · Seafront hotel in Vilanova i la Geltrú
meta.description: Hotel on Passeig Marítim, 88, Vilanova i la Geltrú, facing the beach. Rooms with balcony, air conditioning and breakfast, minutes from the Rambla. Bookings: 934 99 59 27.
meta.ogAlt: Mumm, seafront hotel in Vilanova i la Geltrú

hero.kicker: Passeig Marítim, 88 · Vilanova i la Geltrú
hero.title: A hotel right on the beach, without the fuss
hero.lede: Simple, bright rooms facing the sea, with a balcony, fridge and bathroom. A step from the beach and from the Rambla de la Pau, so you can enjoy Vilanova on foot.

rooms.title: Rooms facing the sea
rooms.lead: Outside-facing rooms with a balcony and private bathroom. Simple, clean, and equipped for a short stay on the coast.

r1.name: Double room with balcony
r1.text: Outside-facing, with a double or twin beds, a balcony and sea or promenade views.

r2.name: Standard double room
r2.text: Outside-facing room without a balcony, same basic equipment and good light.

r3.name: Family room
r3.text: Space for three or four people, practical for short family breaks.

hotel.title: Small, seafront and well placed
hotel.lead: Mumm is a small hotel on the Passeig Marítim, with the beach across the promenade and the Rambla de la Pau five minutes on foot.
hotel.body: It is not a hotel of endless facilities: it is a large guesthouse with outside-facing rooms and personal service. What the reviews praise most is the team and the location; if you are after a pool and a spa, this is not the place.

points.c: Fridge and air conditioning in every room
points.d: The Rambla de la Pau, five minutes on foot

reviews.title: What guests say
reviews.lead: Extracts from reviews published on Google by people who have stayed. The average is 3.7 out of 5 across 477 reviews, with both very good and critical ones — all of them are on Google.

book.title: Call and we will tell you what is free
book.lead: Bookings are taken by phone. Call us and we will confirm availability, price and arrival time.

foot.legal: This page is an information sheet for the hotel. For bookings, availability and terms, please contact the property directly. The reviews shown are extracts from public Google reviews.
